purpose: Attach a machine-checkable quality, performance, OpenSLO/error-budget, maturity-claim, and six-axis conformance evidence packet to one bounded release candidate without mutating product/cloud runtime surfaces or claiming readiness.

release_candidate.candidate_scope: one release-candidate evidence packet for claim-control and conformance validation only
non_goals: no product or cloud runtime mutation
no public SLO or SLA publication

can_claim_now: CONF-001 has one release-candidate evidence packet that names the required benchmark, performance, load-test, OpenSLO/error-budget, claim-control, and six-axis conformance inputs.
The packet is validated by scripts/tests/conf_001_hyperscaler_conformance_check.py for shape, source-backed benchmark citations, blocked claims, and ADR-0134 advisory treatment.

used_for: maturity claim stays blocked until required evidence is present
architecture invariant evidence is advisory until validators and protected CI context exist
SLO/error-budget and performance-capacity evidence are part of the invariant vocabulary
candidate backlog vocabulary for error-budget burn-rate and product-SLO remediation items only
OpenSLO/error-budget production and hyperscaler evidence requirements
OpenTelemetry, OpenSLO, measured-window, and burn-rate evidence vocabulary
explicit nonclaim boundary for measured SLO and public SLA/SLO language

competitor_benchmark_row.dimension: release-candidate evidence gates for performance, SLO/error-budget, reliability, and claim control

oyatie_adopt_decisions: Attach benchmark evidence to the release candidate before any maturity or readiness language is allowed.
Require OpenSLO/error-budget policy and load-test receipt shape even when the current slice is metadata-only.
Keep ADR-0134 remediation items advisory until future validators, fixtures, workflows, and protected contexts exist.
oyatie_improve_beyond_actions: Make the release-candidate packet machine-checkable by a repo-local stdlib Python validator.
Record explicit nonclaim language next to each target so future promotion work cannot confuse target shape with measured evidence.
Bind the six ADR-0133 conformance axes into the same release-candidate fixture instead of scattering them across chat or prose-only docs.
competitor_benchmark_row.claim_boundary: source-backed benchmark row only; no superiority, parity, readiness, or measured performance claim

performance_target.target_surface: control-plane API and evidence-gate release candidate
capacity_and_scalability_targets: state strategy declared before release promotion
active-active compatibility or explicit exception declared before release promotion
per-cell capacity envelope declared before release promotion
scale-out trigger metrics declared before release promotion
cross-region story declared before release promotion

explicit_na_for_this_slice.runtime_load_test_run: N/A: this task is evidence/gate only and does not mutate or run product/cloud runtime surfaces
explicit_na_for_this_slice.measured_latency: N/A: future release-candidate runtime run must attach values
explicit_na_for_this_slice.measured_throughput: N/A: future release-candidate runtime run must attach values

release_decision_rules: fast-burn threshold pages and freezes or throttles release promotion
slow-burn threshold opens owner action and rollback review
error-budget exhaustion blocks positive readiness or maturity language until recovery evidence is attached
external hyperscaler console screenshots do not satisfy Oyatie-owned dogfood telemetry evidence
openslo_error_budget_policy.nonclaim_boundary: OpenSLO/error-budget policy shape only; no measured SLO, public SLA/SLO, production-readiness, tenant-workload readiness, or hyperscaler-maturity claim

blocked_claim_patterns: better than competitor without source-backed evidence
maturity_claim_evidence.review_rule: Any future PR that upgrades this fixture from target_non_claim must attach current-head CI, dogfood runtime evidence, reviewer approval, and explicit rollback/observability evidence.

axes.name: Pipeline conformance
axes.release_candidate_requirement: map release evidence through build, test, security-scan, SBOM, sign, deploy, verify, and promote stages before promotion claims

axes.name: Directory conformance
axes.release_candidate_requirement: new evidence artifacts stay under evidence/conformance and runtime/product files are not modified by this gate slice

axes.name: Naming conformance
axes.release_candidate_requirement: artifact, section, and validator IDs use deterministic CONF-001 names and stable evidence keys

axes.name: Standards conformance
axes.release_candidate_requirement: release-candidate packet cites source standards for observability, SLO, security, docs, review, and testing expectations

axes.name: Practices conformance for agentic development
axes.release_candidate_requirement: validator fails closed on missing evidence sections, blocked-claim omissions, proposed-ADR elevation, and incomplete six-axis rows

axes.name: Policies conformance
axes.release_candidate_requirement: policy and tenant-isolation evidence remain prerequisites before any positive readiness or maturity language

fixture_assertions: all six ADR-0133 axes are present exactly once
each axis names at least one industry baseline and one release-candidate requirement
ADR-0134 is treated as Proposed/advisory only
positive claim language remains blocked until future measured/runtime and branch-protected evidence exists
